newsitem.title: CHINA: VW China venture posts big sales rise.
newsitem.headline: VW China venture posts big sales rise.

text.p: Sales of Jetta sedan cars at Volkswagen Corp's joint venture in China's nortern Changchun have soared 88.7 percent year-on-year in the first quarter, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The firm sold 8,945 Jetta cars in the first three months, Xinhua said.
The joint venture with China First Automotive Corp produced more than 9,000 cars from January to March, up 29.3 percent from the same period last year, it said.
The joint venture boasts China's first modern assembly line, completed last year, with a production capacity for 150,000 cars a year, Xinhua said.
